name: Brazoria County, TX
findings: Brazoria County has 1,039 nonprofit organizations. 361 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 251 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Brazoria County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Brazoria County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 research and think tank organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 106 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 106 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
